根据所提供的资料，无法完整回答“图 5.7(b) 中 20° 阳极角下焦点形状从阴极侧向阳极侧如何变化”这一问题。原因如下：

**1. 图 5.7(b) 本身未提供**

资料中仅在图 5.7 的图注里提到“(b) graphic representation of the focal spot shape at different locations in the radiation field (anode angle 20°)”[1]，即该图是“辐射野内不同位置处焦点形状的图示（阳极角 20°）”。但图 5.7(b) 的图像内容并未包含在所提供的文本资料中，因此无法描述图中焦点形状的具体几何变化。

**2. 文字资料只说明了尺寸变化趋势，未说明形状变化**

资料中与图 5.7(b) 相关的文字表述为：实际焦点尺寸取决于视野内的位置，**从阳极侧向阴极侧增大**[2]；另一处也表述为有效焦点尺寸**从阳极侧向阴极侧单调增大**[3]。

这些表述说明的是焦点**尺寸（大小）**沿阴极—阳极方向的单调变化趋势，并未描述焦点**形状**（例如是圆形、椭圆形、矩形，以及长轴方向、长短轴比例等）如何随位置改变。因此，即使结合文字，也只能得出“尺寸由阳极侧向阴极侧增大”这一结论，不能据此推断形状变化。

**3. 可确认的相关背景（非形状描述）**

- 电子焦点在射线方向上按 sin θ 缩短，形成有效焦点[2]。
- 诊断用 X 射线管阳极角范围为 6°–22°，通用管常用 10°–16°[2]。
- 焦点尺寸的标称值是对中心束定义的，而实际焦点尺寸随视野内位置变化[2]。

**结论与局限**

- 依据现有资料可确认：在 20° 阳极角下，焦点尺寸从阳极侧向阴极侧增大[2][3]。
- 关于图 5.7(b) 所示焦点**形状**的具体变化，所提供资料中缺少该图的图像内容及相应文字描述，无法作答。
- 若需回答形状问题，需要提供图 5.7(b) 的图像本身，或教材中对该图焦点形状的明确文字说明。

The anode is inclined to the tube axis, typically with the central ray of 
the X ray field perpendicular to the tube axis. The electrons hit the anode in the 
electronic focus, largely determined by the length of the cathode filament. The 
electronic focus appears shortened in beam direction by sin θ as the effective 
focus (Fig.  5.7(a)). Anode angles in diagnostic tubes range from 6° to 22°, 
depending on their task, with 10–16° used for general purpose tubes. The radial 
dimension of the focus size is given by the filament coil diameter and the action 
of the focusing cup. The size of the focal spot of an X ray tube is given for the 
central beam in the X ray field running perpendicular to the electron beam or the 
tube axis. The actual focal spot size depends on the position within the field of 
view, increasing from the anode side of the tube to the cathode (Fig. 5.7(b)).
The reduction of anode angles to achieve smaller effective focus sizes is 
limited by the size of the field of view required as the X ray beam is cut off by 
the anode. A further limit is given by the heel effect (Fig. 5.8). Here, the X rays

The degree of focusing depends on the potential difference or bias voltage 
between the filament and focusing electrode. The focal spot will be largest if both 
are at the same potential. With an increasing negative bias voltage at the focusing 
cup, the focus size will decrease and finally the electron current will be pinched 
off. This effect is sometimes used to control the focus size electronically, or for
